summary: Re-tested per iteration_2 handoff after switching preview to a production `next build && next start` (plus FastAPI /api/* proxy on :8001 and expanded allowedDevOrigins). All requested checks now PASS end-to-end through the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor (carry-over, not blocking): no client-side email regex mirror of the server EMAIL_REGEX; only HTML5 type=email is used.
Minor: submit button relies solely on `sending` state flag; a very rapid double-click before setSending resolves could theoretically double-post.
seed_data_creation: One real Resend sandbox email sent during e2e test (name='TEST QA', email='qa@example.test').
context_for_next_testing_agent: PRIMARY BUG FROM iteration_2 IS RESOLVED. Under the production build served via `next start` behind the :8001 FastAPI /api/* proxy, React hydration completes correctly on /contact (form element now has __reactFiber$ and __reactProps$ keys). Contact form submit -> POST /api/contact -> Resend returns 200 -> contact-success renders within seconds. contact-reset clears all three inputs. SPA client navigation (nav-link-home/systems/about/contact) works without full reload errors. All 4 pages return HTTP 200 with correct H1s ('High-technology tools for the people the world overlooked.', 'Systems & platforms', 'Built by people who\'ve lived through broken systems.', 'Contact mission control'). All three Dream Funnel links (nav-dreamfunnel, hero-dreamfunnel, footer-dreamfunnel) have href='https://dreamfunnel.net' and target='_blank'.
rca_of_the_issue: iteration_2 failure was caused by Turbopack dev-server client chunks not hydrating behind the Emergent preview proxy (TURBOPACK_CHUNK_LISTS undefined, no React fiber/props on the form element, resulting in native HTML form GET on submit). Switching the preview to a Next.js production build (`next build && next start`) removed the Turbopack dev chunk loader from the runtime; the standard production client bundle hydrates reliably behind the proxy. Combined with the FastAPI /api/* -> :3000 proxy (fixes /api/* 502) and additional preview hosts in allowedDevOrigins, the full contact flow now works end-to-end.
